svg.title: Keeper memory pressure and ClickHouse restarts
svg.desc: Four panels show Keeper memory near its soft limit, CPU throttling, ClickHouse file pressure, and replica queues. These measurements fall after the Keeper resize and rolling restart.
svg.text: Keeper memory pressure and ClickHouse restarts
All times Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8). Prometheus samples at 5-minute intervals.
Default soft limit ≈ 1.8 GiB before resize (working set is a separate measurement)
Largest replication queue on any table (operations)
Each line is one pod. Read-file gauges exclude write files and sockets; sampled peaks can miss the descriptor limit.
Keeper memory rejection is proven by client logs and matched source; this chart shows the surrounding resource and recovery pattern.
